tagline.en: Galaxea G0Plus — an open vision-language-action base model built on PaliGemma, meant to be fine-tuned into task-ready policies.
tagline.zh: Galaxea G0Plus——构建在 PaliGemma 之上的开放视觉-语言-动作基座模型,面向微调为可用策略。

en: Galaxea G0Plus is a vision-language-action (VLA) model from OpenGalaxea. It reads camera observations and an instruction and predicts robot actions, using a PaliGemma-based multimodal backbone paired with a flow-sampling action expert.

The released G0Plus checkpoint is a base model intended as a starting point for downstream fine-tuning rather than a finished, task-ready policy. Its architecture — the model, KV cache, flow sampler, tokenizer adapter, preprocessing, and normalization — is implemented in WorldFoundry, and it pairs with the google/paligemma-3b-pt-224 backbone. Normalization relies on the exact dataset statistics paired with the checkpoint, so those must be staged alongside the weights.
In WorldFoundry, G0Plus runs from staged local assets — provide observations and the matching statistics, and it returns actions for rollout or as a base for your own fine-tune.
zh: Galaxea G0Plus 是 OpenGalaxea 推出的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型。它读取相机观测与指令并预测机器人动作,采用基于 PaliGemma 的多模态主干,搭配 flow 采样的 action expert。

已发布的 G0Plus checkpoint 是一个基座模型,定位为下游微调的起点,而非开箱即用的成品策略。其架构——模型本体、KV 缓存、flow 采样器、tokenizer 适配器、预处理与归一化——在 WorldFoundry 中实现,并与 google/paligemma-3b-pt-224 主干配套使用。归一化依赖与 checkpoint 配套的精确数据集统计量,因此需要将它们与权重一并准备好。
在 WorldFoundry 中,G0Plus 从本地准备好的资产运行——提供观测与匹配的统计量,它就返回可用于 rollout 的动作,或作为你自己微调的基座。

whenToUse.en: Use G0Plus as a foundation to fine-tune into your own manipulation policy, especially if you want an openly available PaliGemma-based VLA to build on.
whenToUse.zh: 把 G0Plus 当作基座,微调成你自己的操作策略——尤其当你希望在一个开放可得、基于 PaliGemma 的 VLA 之上构建时。

notFor.en: Don't expect the base checkpoint to solve tasks out of the box; it's meant for fine-tuning. It also needs the exact paired dataset statistics — normalization won't fall back to made-up values — plus the PaliGemma backbone, both downloaded separately.
notFor.zh: 不要指望基座 checkpoint 开箱即用地完成任务,它是用来微调的。它还需要与之配套的精确数据集统计量(归一化不会退回到编造的数值),以及 PaliGemma 主干,两者均需单独下载。

en: Open VLA base model from OpenGalaxea
PaliGemma-based backbone with a flow action expert
Requires the exact paired dataset statistics for normalization
zh: 来自 OpenGalaxea 的开放 VLA 基座模型
